ratings_why.fun: Funeral order is a real puzzle each turn, and Old Fingers, Undertaker and Inkcap all get used against their obvious job; I'd happily draft it.
ratings_why.distinct: Folding sale into death is fresh, but the fight half is the familiar 'dying units leave growing tokens' shape of many auto-battler tribes.

verdict_why: The core is settled, but the scope of 'sell triggers fire in fights' is a rules hole that changes how other tribes play and needs one clear line.

points.text: 'Sell triggers fire in fights and death triggers fire in the shop' doesn't say whose triggers. If it covers other tribes, a Bird that dies in a fight Flies South and comes home doubled, and a sold Ooze opens its Belly; say whether that is meant or limit it to Guild cards.
Clerk Inkcap doesn't say whether its own death (from losing Health or in a fight) triggers it. Say yes or no, since it decides whether he ends with one last buff.

Old Fingers plus a Bird on Fly South (a copy fights while it's away) and selling a Sexton-fed unit at the end of the turn are the best hidden combos here; list them in the builds so players find them.
Black-Gloved Undertaker beside one of Old Fingers' Fruit copies kills a copy for its Attack and a Sprout; worth stating whether copies are summoned before Undertaker picks his target.
Raindrop Puffball is the only card that reads only 'this fight'; letting it also read the Register (like Lamplighter) would tie the late burst to the Wake build too.

standouts.why: Old Fingers turns selling into a choice about who fights next turn, and competes with Fruit for empty slots.
Clerk Inkcap is a buffer that is also a fuse, so Health buffs become fuel; a true off-label card.
Undertaker as a Start of Combat trigger for Fruit, Bellies and Amanita gives many cross-tribe uses.

weakest.why: Funeral Steward is a plain once-a-turn gold tick with nothing to combine.
Foxfire Lamplighter just reads the Register and grows; no decision around it.
Crape Spinner is a flat Sprout aura that does the one obvious job.

flags.note: Whether other tribes' sell and death triggers swap places under laid to rest (Fly South on death, Belly on sale).
Candlesnuff Abbess with Bootlace Cordwainer makes two Sprouts per use for six uses; bounded, but the biggest in-fight swing.
Does its own death trigger it?
